boundaries: No scientific output is read or printed during TR4 preflight.
No primary/alignment/robustness result is computed before explicit TR4 approval.
defect: Frozen csra_v08_analysis._design_vector hard-codes analysis_relation="country_of_origin". The sealed selected common set has zero country_of_origin items, so this level is absent from the fitted Patsy design and an alignment contrast row would fail with an unseen categorical level.
frozen_alignment_formula: VSA_z ~ CIE_z * SELF * C(model_key) + C(frozen_answer_role) + baseline_margin_z + C(strength) + C(analysis_relation)
frozen_common_formula: VSA_z ~ CIE_z * SELF + C(model_key) * CIE_z + C(model_key) * SELF + C(frozen_answer_role) + baseline_margin_z + C(strength) + C(analysis_relation)
invariance_basis: The four-point CIE-by-SELF interaction contrast subtracts additive nuisance contributions exactly. C(frozen_answer_role), C(strength), C(analysis_relation), and baseline_margin_z enter additively only in the frozen alignment formula; therefore any valid fixed nuisance row yields the same interaction contrast vector.
repair: Do not modify the frozen analysis module on disk. For alignment only, monkeypatch _design_vector in memory so nuisance categorical values are chosen deterministically from levels observed in the fitted data. The fitted data, formula, CIE/VSA values, bootstrap resamples, optimizers, seeds, and estimands remain unchanged.
trigger: Static inspection of frozen alignment contrast helper before predictive/inferential analysis.
